content:
Good morning! I am encountering an issue where, when editing a tactic proof, re-typing or indenting a tactic will cause the previous tactic to re-run, which is slightly annoying when that tactic has a long execution time. A bit of investigation reveals this is likely because the previous tactic's trailing whitespace and thus its syntax is considered "modified" (even though that doesn't changed what it is parsed to), and the language server snapshots the proof state based on the concrete syntax tree not the abstract one.

Example (using the VSCode Lean plugin):

example : True := by
  long_running_tactic
  trivial -- re-typing this causes `long_running_tactic` to run again even though it wasn't changed :(

I am curious if this is a fundamental limitation of the language server, or if there is a way around it? Thank you!
I thought this was fixed recently? On which version are you?
Yeah, lean4#11958 should have fixed this as far as I can tell; you should be able to have it working on versions v4.33.0 and later
Aha this looks like it. I was on 4.32; should have tested on the most recent version. Thank you very much!
